lines: Atul Hiralal Shah, Investor Selling Shareholder, is receiving money from selling up to 12,600 shares in the offer for sale.
Proceeds of up to ₹1.70 crore if all offered shares are sold; the money has been in hand since 11 Mar 2026.
Retained shares of ₹3.97 crore (estimate) unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, so more money may come later from that holding.
